nancy.author: John Harrington

summary.t: Represented Baltimore in the U.S. House from 1939 to 1947, then served as mayor of Baltimore from 1947 to 1959. Worked as an insurance and real estate broker before politics.
Known as Nancy. Emigrated to the U.S. from Fornelli, in southern Italy, in 1912. Active in politics, organizing Democratic women.
Her eldest brother. President of the Baltimore City Council in the 1960s and mayor of Baltimore from 1967 to 1971.

Has represented San Francisco in the U.S. House since 1987. Speaker of the House from 2007 to 2011 and from 2019 to 2023. Announced in November 2025 that she won’t seek reelection; her term ends Jan. 3, 2027.

worth.by: Quiver Quantitative estimate, based on her disclosures

record.t: Filed May 15, 2026. It lists 14 assets worth $5,000,001 to $25,000,000 each: Paul’s shares of Apple, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Nvidia, Broadcom, Salesforce and Visa, plus real estate holdings, including two commercial buildings in San Francisco and the couple’s home and vineyard in St. Helena, Calif. House forms report values in ranges.
“Speaker Pelosi does not own any stocks, and she has no prior knowledge or subsequent involvement in any transactions,” her office said in January 2025.
Said in a video on Nov. 6, 2025, “I will not be seeking reelection to Congress.”

facts.t: The 14 largest holdings on her 2025 report add up to at least $70 million and at most $350 million (our math from the ranges).
Her father and her brother were both mayors of Baltimore.
Voted for the STOCK Act in 2012.

kidsNote.t: Nancy and Paul have five adult children: Nancy Corinne, Christine, Jacqueline, Paul Jr. and Alexandra.

summary.t: Businessman who owns and runs Financial Leasing Services, a San Francisco real estate and venture capital investment and consulting firm. The trades on Nancy’s reports are filed under the spouse (SP) owner code.

worth.none: No published estimate of his own.

owns.t: Owns and runs it. Nancy’s 2025 report values it at $100,001 to $250,000 and lists his salary from it, with no amount given.

record.t: Bought 50 Nvidia call options with an $80 strike price on Jan. 14, 2025 ($250,001 to $500,000), and exercised them for 5,000 shares on Jan. 16, 2026. Sold 20,000 Nvidia shares on Dec. 24, 2025 ($1,000,001 to $5,000,000). The 2025 annual report lists his Nvidia shares at $5,000,001 to $25,000,000.
The report filed Jan. 23, 2026 also shows a sale of 45,000 Apple shares ($5,000,001 to $25,000,000) and gifts of Apple and Alphabet shares to a donor-advised fund.
Bought Bloom Energy and Intel shares and call options on July 24 and 28, 2026, worth $3.75 million to $13.5 million in total, Benzinga reported from the August 2026 filing.

summary.t: Lawyer, author and Democratic Party official. Chaired the California Democratic Party’s Women’s Caucus from 2011 to 2021 and has served on the Democratic National Committee. Wrote The Nancy Pelosi Way (2019).

facts.t: Decided not to run for her mother’s House seat. She is running for the California State Senate in 2028.
